source: Microsoft Edge online TTS via edge-tts (https://github.com/rany2/edge-tts)
policy: Slow speed only. Each character is recorded alone; polyphonic characters are spoken via a single-reading homophone with the same toned pinyin so the audio matches the displayed pinyin. Group clips join the 4 character clips with 0.45 s pauses.
note: Readings still need human review (拼音与释义仍待校订).
